name: Marvel
description: Marvel is a design and prototyping platform that lets teams create interactive mockups, generate developer handoff specs automatically, and validate designs with integrated user testing.
best_for: Design teams from startups to Fortune 100 companies and schools who want fast, code-free prototyping and design-to-development handoff.
features: Interactive prototyping from low- to high-fidelity designs
Full-screen mobile prototype viewing on iOS and Android apps
Multiple device frames including iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Android

alternatives.name: Figma
alternatives.description: A collaborative interface design tool with real-time multiplayer editing.
alternatives.best_for: Product design teams needing collaborative UI/UX design and prototyping.

alternatives.name: Sketch
alternatives.description: A vector-based UI design tool for macOS with a large plugin ecosystem.
alternatives.best_for: Mac-based design teams wanting a mature, plugin-extensible design tool.

alternatives.name: Zeplin
alternatives.description: A design delivery platform generating developer specs and AI-powered design reviews.
alternatives.best_for: Product teams needing clean, structured design-to-development handoffs.
